title: Quiet Lake Website Loop
tests: Tests whether the delivered website background has subtle real motion and a visually seamless repeat rather than merely being a short scenic video.

faults.what: The supplied audio report indicates audible music or ambience, contrary to the explicit request for no sound.
The clip runs 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: The clip provides a calm, fixed mountain-lake view with subtle ripples, but it includes unwanted audio and exceeds the requested duration.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is a 6-second landscape 16:9 video showing a mountain lake at dusk.
must_haves.why: The landscape framing and dusk mountain-lake scene match, but the reported duration is 6.6 seconds.

must_haves.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water; the output is not a static image held for six seconds.
must_haves.why: Ripple patterns and reflected mountain edges subtly change across the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The camera remains fixed, with no pans, zooms or scene cuts.
must_haves.why: Mountain peaks, shoreline rocks and framing remain aligned across all four samples.

must_haves.item: Repeated playback has no perceptible jump, flash or abrupt motion reset at the boundary.
must_haves.why: The samples do not show the actual end-to-start transition, so seamless playback cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The centre remains visually calm, without prominent moving foreground objects competing with a website heading.
must_haves.why: The centre contains subdued sky, distant mountains and gently rippling water, with no prominent moving foreground objects.

must_haves.item: There is no visible text and no audible sound.
must_haves.why: No text is visible, but the audio report identifies music or ambience with a peak of -9 dB.
